reuse.why: No helper existed for this rule; the change adds one guard and calls it from each existing provider link handler without re-implementing anything, though it types the provider as a plain string rather than the existing sync-source type.

duplication.why: The rule and its query are written once; each handler only adds a one-call line with its provider and account id.

placement.why: The guard sits in accounts/app.ts beside the link handlers and runs at the top of each before any bank, account or payee is created.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five calls and a release note.

maintainability.why: Simple and clear single rule; each future provider must remember to call it, and the change ships without tests.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in accounts/app.ts, called by all five provider link handlers (GoCardless, SimpleFin, Pluggy.ai, Akahu, Enable Banking)
